name: countdown-api-codegen
description: The Node tools: openapi-typescript writes src/countdown_api/store.d.ts from the contract's schemas, TypeScript checks it and client.ts (tsconfig.json), Biome lints and formats the TypeScript and JSON (biome.json), `node --test` runs client.ts's tests, and openapi-generator (a Java program: openapitools.json pins its version, which this command downloads) writes the C++ headers in cpp/countdown_api from the templates in templates/cpp.
